notes: GAAP. Governmental funds only (no enterprise/proprietary funds; fiduciary/custodial funds not in the trim). Receipts/disbursements from the Total Governmental Funds column of the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances (p6). debt_proceeds = Leases 13,201,888 + Proceeds of refunding bonds 44,565,000 (other financing sources); other_financing = Payments to refund bonds (44,260,000). Roll-forward: 206,359,442 + 412,425,510 - 399,711,267 + 18,924,567 - 18,924,567 + 57,766,888 - 44,260,000 = 232,580,573 (ties). ending_cash = Cash and pooled investments from the governmental funds Balance Sheet total column (p5); restricted assets 42,324,301 separate; no beginning cash printed. Balance sheet = government-wide Statement of Net Position (p3), single Governmental Activities column. governmental_net_position from the Statement of Activities (p4; no restatement printed). Detail: General Fund (pp7-8), Road (p9) and Health Center (p10) budget-basis schedules (budget basis differs from GAAP; GF lines with '-' actuals not recorded; some GF actuals printed with cents, recorded as printed); the FY2022 trim has no individual nonmajor-fund budget schedules, so every nonmajor fund (DC Justice Center is nonmajor in FY2022) is recorded per fund column from the Combining Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances - Non-Major Governmental Funds (pp11-13); Law Enforcement and CAA columns are all zero. Tourism 'Other' taxes 4,796,928 are Miscellaneous Tax per the Douglas County ruling; the statement's Miscellaneous taxes line 7,393,113 also includes General Fund 2,596,185 and stays other taxes. Capital outlay labelled with a function only where the fund name names it (Bridge, Health Department). The p6 Nonmajor column prints Public health 23,220,345 and Bond interest 1,601,958 vs 23,220,346 and 1,601,957 on pp12-13 ($1 rounding in the report; nonmajor detail taken from pp11-13). Pages 1-2 are table-of-contents pages; pages 14-18 are statistical schedules with no money data. Read pages 1-18 of 18
